# Desert Liquid Glass

Installable Astra-compatible WordPress theme. Owns generic presentation, tokens, page modes, media planes, responsive behavior, accessibility, reduced motion, admin settings, and WooCommerce styling.

Free/Pro: Free is active by default. Pro is unconfigured and fails closed. No remote licensing contract is assumed.

Optional integration: Renew-48 plugin. The theme never stores or processes Renew-48 business state.
